propositions: Top-level CLI help (rebar --help) and ticket-model documentation incorrectly state unlink takes no relation argument, contradicting the actual optional relation parameter added in commit 73abb5805f.
The event-schema documentation uses pre-change operation wording that fails to distinguish the optional relation selector from the emitted UNLINK event's link_uuid cancellation semantics.
Commit 73abb5805f updated subcommand-specific help and generated user/reference docs but omitted the independently maintained overview.txt and ticket-model.md surfaces, leaving them stale.

The documented and actual contracts must clarify that explicit relation removal targets exactly that relation while preserving other active relations on the pair, and that omitted relation defaults to most-recent.
Existing interface tests prove correct behavior: explicit relation-scoped removal and omission fallback, but live help contradiction demonstrates the published documentation surfaces are outdated.
